verdict.rationale: Guidance content on inpi.fr (trademark, patent, design and e-Soleau filing pages, plus directives) appears in the evidence pack as retrieved text, which suggests the public reading surface is readable without a key. However, no probe of inpi.fr itself confirms the absence of a bot wall, JS-only shell or CAPTCHA, and the only access probe shows the sibling data.inpi.fr portal returning HTTP 403 to a keyless agent. That probe concerns the open-data portal rather than the guidance pages, so it is not a direct contradiction. missing for 10: a direct keyless-GET probe of inpi.fr guidance pages with an identified user agent showing HTTP 200 and server-rendered content, independent corroboration of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and confirmation that the 403 behaviour seen on data.inpi.fr does not extend to the guidance surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Les directives illustrent la mise en pratique par l'INPI des textes législatifs, de la jurisprudence nationale et de l'Union européenne (UE)
